title: Scientists discover a surprising secret behind the human brain’s wrinkles
caption:
While most primate brains are highly folded like a walnut, the common marmoset has a surprisingly smooth surface. New research using lab-grown mini-brains reveals the cellular 'speed limit' that keeps their brains small and simple.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a surprising secret behind the human brain’s wrinkles

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261021231235.htm
